title: Basing One-Way Functions on NP-Hardness
exact_target: Can worst-case NP-hardness alone be turned into the average-case inversion hardness needed for one-way functions?

sources.citation: A. Akavia, O. Goldreich, S. Goldwasser and D. Moshkovitz, 'On basing one-way functions on NP-hardness', Proc. 38th Annual ACM Symp. on Theory of Computing (STOC), 2006, pp. 701-710. DOI:10.1145/1132516.1132614.
Hardness Along the Boundary: Towards One-Way Functions from the Worst-case Hardness of Time-Bounded Kolmogorov Complexity.
Capturing One-Way Functions via NP-Hardness of Meta-Complexity.
